cards.name: CGMExport
cards.summary: The object CorelDRAW hands back when a script exports to Computer Graphics Metafile (.cgm); it carries the CGM writer's options (version/profile, binary or text encoding, S1000D/ATA identifiers) until Finish writes the file.
use_for: technical-illustration delivery as .cgm for S1000D / ATA manuals
WebCGM figures for an IETM viewer
batch-exporting parts drawings to CGM
avoid: general print or web delivery: CGM is a technical-publishing format; use PDF, EPS or SVG export instead
cards.how: COM coclass of the CGM export filter (FilterCGMLib). A script never news it up: ActiveDocument.ExportEx(path, cdrCGM) returns this object typed as ICorelExportFilter, and its settings are the ICGMExport members (Format, FileEncoding, ICN, ExportLayers ...), applied before Finish.

key_members.name: Format
key_members.use: CgmFormat: CGM version or profile (plain versions, WebCGM, GREX, S1000D issues) (on default interface ICGMExport)

key_members.name: FileEncoding
key_members.use: CgmFileEncoding: binary (compact, usual) or clear-text CGM (on default interface ICGMExport)

key_members.name: ICN
key_members.use: string: Information Control Number for S1000D-style illustration naming (meaning per profile is unverified) (on default interface ICGMExport)

key_members.name: ExportLayers
key_members.use: bool: write CorelDRAW layers as CGM layers (on default interface ICGMExport)

key_members.name: Reset
key_members.use: restore the filter's default options (on default interface ICGMExport)

key_members.name: Finish
key_members.use: run the export and write the .cgm (on default interface ICGMExport)

gotchas: Creatable (cancreate), but a free-standing CGMExport is not bound to any document or file; get it from the ExportEx call instead (unverified)

Python win32com with makepy/EnsureDispatch wraps the return value as the generic ICorelExportFilter / ICorelImportFilter, so filter-specific properties raise AttributeError; re-wrap late-bound with win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(f._oleobj_) (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim f As Object  ' CGMExport behind ICorelExportFilter
Set f = ActiveDocument.ExportEx("C:\out\fig01.cgm", cdrCGM)
f.Reset   ' start from the filter defaults
f.Finish  ' writes the .cgm

review.changes: key_members listed the interface name ICGMExport, which is not a member; replaced with the default interface's real members (Format, FileEncoding, ICN, ExportLayers, Reset, Finish)

cards.name: CGMImport
cards.summary: The object CorelDRAW returns when a script imports a Computer Graphics Metafile (.cgm) onto a layer; it holds the CGM reader's options (an optional XML companion file) until Finish places the artwork.
use_for: bringing customer CGM technical illustrations into CorelDRAW for touch-up
batch-converting legacy .cgm figures to CDR/PDF
avoid: sources that also exist as PDF/SVG/EPS: those keep more styling than CGM
cards.how: COM coclass of the CGM import filter (FilterCGMLib). ActiveLayer.ImportEx(path, cdrCGM) returns it typed as ICorelImportFilter; its one specific setting is ICGMImport.XCFFileName, set before Finish.

key_members.name: XCFFileName
key_members.use: string: full path of the XML companion file to read with the CGM (unverified) (on default interface ICGMImport)

key_members.name: Reset
key_members.use: restore default import options (on default interface ICGMImport)

key_members.name: Finish
key_members.use: run the import; the CGM content lands on the target layer (on default interface ICGMImport)

gotchas: Creatable (cancreate), but a free-standing CGMImport is not bound to any document or file; get it from the ImportEx call instead (unverified)

Python win32com with makepy/EnsureDispatch wraps the return value as the generic ICorelExportFilter / ICorelImportFilter, so filter-specific properties raise AttributeError; re-wrap late-bound with win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(f._oleobj_) (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim f As Object  ' CGMImport behind ICorelImportFilter
Set f = ActiveLayer.ImportEx("C:\in\fig01.cgm", cdrCGM)
f.Reset
f.Finish  ' places the drawing on the layer

review.changes: key_members listed the interface name ICGMImport, which is not a member; replaced with the default interface's real members (XCFFileName, Reset, Finish)

cards.name: ICGMExport
cards.summary: Option interface of CorelDRAW's CGM (Computer Graphics Metafile) export: picks the CGM version or industry profile (WebCGM, GREX, S1000D issues), binary vs clear-text encoding, number precision, colour model and text encoding, and the ICN / GNBR identifiers that technical-publication profiles expect.
use_for: S1000D / ATA GREX illustration delivery as .cgm
WebCGM output for interactive electronic manuals
keeping layers as CGM layers for a tech-pubs CMS
avoid: ordinary print/web artwork: CGM viewers are niche and effects/transparency flatten or drop; use PDF, EPS or SVG export
guessing profile values: the Format value must match the customer's CGM profile spec
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual) inheriting ICorelExportFilter. Reach it through ActiveDocument.ExportEx("x.cgm", cdrCGM), which returns the filter; set the properties, then call Finish. Enum-typed properties take values of CgmFormat, CgmFileEncoding, CgmOutputPrecision, CgmCharsetMode, CgmFallbackCode, CgmTextEncoding and CgmColorMode (see those enum cards).

key_members.name: Format
key_members.use: CgmFormat: CGM version or profile (plain versions, WebCGM, GREX, S1000D issues)

key_members.name: FileEncoding
key_members.use: CgmFileEncoding: binary (compact, usual) or clear-text CGM

key_members.name: ICN
key_members.use: string: Information Control Number for S1000D-style illustration naming (meaning per profile is unverified)

key_members.name: GNBR
key_members.use: string: graphic number used by ATA-style profiles (unverified)

key_members.name: OutputPrecision
key_members.use: CgmOutputPrecision: integer 16-bit vs real 32-bit coordinates

key_members.name: ColorMode
key_members.use: CgmColorMode: indexed palette vs direct colour

key_members.name: TextEncoding
key_members.use: CgmTextEncoding: how text strings are encoded in the file

key_members.name: CharsetMode
key_members.use: CgmCharsetMode: strict vs relaxed character-set handling

key_members.name: FallbackCode
key_members.use: CgmFallbackCode: Unicode encoding used when a character falls outside the chosen set (unverified)

key_members.name: ExportLayers
key_members.use: bool: write CorelDRAW layers as CGM layers

key_members.name: IncludeXCF
key_members.use: bool: also write an XML companion file (XCF) next to the CGM (unverified)

key_members.name: Reset
key_members.use: restore the filter's default options

key_members.name: Finish
key_members.use: run the export and write the .cgm

key_members.name: HasDialog
key_members.use: read-only: whether the CGM filter has an options dialog

key_members.name: ShowDialog
key_members.use: open that dialog (optional hWnd owner); returns bool

gotchas: Nothing is written until Finish is called; a script that sets properties and stops leaves no file (unverified)
ShowDialog opens a modal options dialog and blocks an unattended run; never call it in a headless pipeline

Python win32com with makepy/EnsureDispatch wraps the return value as the generic ICorelExportFilter / ICorelImportFilter, so filter-specific properties raise AttributeError; re-wrap late-bound with win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(f._oleobj_) (unverified)
ExternalSettings is a hidden, read-only string; do not build on it (what it serialises is unverified)
A profile Format (WebCGM / S1000D) may constrain what the other options can be; check the written file in the target validator (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim f As Object
Set f = ActiveDocument.ExportEx("C:\out\fig01.cgm", cdrCGM)
f.ExportLayers = True
f.ICN = "ICN-DEMO-00001-A-01"
f.IncludeXCF = False
f.Finish

review.changes: use_for: 'ATA iSpec 2200' replaced with the harvested GREX profile name
